page.overview:
Who is Borgin?

Borgin was a male Human lieutenant of the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic, he was posted on Taris, where he asked an Imperial to defeat a group of Republic ambushers that was preying on Imperial convoys.

entity.description: Børgin is a fjord branch in the eastern part of Trondheimsfjorden in Steinkjer Municipality and Inderøy Municipality in Trøndelag county, Norway. The 10-kilometre (6.2 mi) long fjord is about 1 to 3 kilometres (0.62 to 1.86 mi) wide, although the mouth of the fjord is only 100 metres (330 ft) wide. The mouth of the fjord is by the village of Straumen and there is a bridge across the fjord at its narrowest point.
